data.topic: retrieval-augmented generation在客户支持查询场景的评估
data.summary: 本文评估1200条产品支持查询上的retrieval-augmented generation流水线，最优配置结合dense retriever与re-ranking model，将答案忠实度从68%提升至81%，但out-of-domain查询时所有流水线性能下降，归因于knowledge base覆盖不足，同时发布CC-BY许可的评估数据集。

claims.claim: dense retriever结合re-ranking model可提升retrieval-augmented generation流水线的答案忠实度
claims.evidence: The best configuration combines a dense retriever with a re-ranking model, improving answer faithfulness from 68% to 81% over the baseline.

claims.claim: 所有retrieval-augmented generation流水线在out-of-domain查询上性能下降，原因是knowledge base覆盖不足
claims.evidence: all pipelines degrade on out-of-domain queries, which we attribute to sparse coverage in the knowledge base.

facts.fact: 本次评估针对1200条产品支持查询开展
facts.evidence: We evaluate retrieval-augmented generation pipelines on 1,200 product-support queries.

facts.fact: 最优配置将答案忠实度从68%提升至81%
facts.evidence: improving answer faithfulness from 68% to 81% over the baseline.

facts.fact: 评估数据集以CC-BY许可发布
facts.evidence: We release the evaluation dataset under CC-BY license.
